local function SendPublicChat(msg)
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                local channel = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels") and TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
                if channel then channel:SendAsync(msg) end
            end
            local sayRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if sayRemote then sayRemote:FireServer(msg, "All") end
        end)
    end)
end

-- Advanced Invisible Unicode Character Engine to Help Bypass Filters
local function AdvancedBypassChat(msg)
    local bypassedMsg = ""
    for i = 1, #msg do
        local char = msg:sub(i,i)
        bypassedMsg = bypassedMsg .. char
        if char ~= " " and i < #msg then
            bypassedMsg = bypassedMsg .. "◌" 
        end
    end
    SendPublicChat(bypassedMsg)
end

local function makeDraggable(f)
    local d, di, ds, sp
    f.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            d = true; ds = i.Position; sp = f.Position
        end
    end)
    f.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then di = i end
    end)
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if d and di then
            local delta = di.Position - ds
            f.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + delta.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then d = false end
    end)
end

--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!

--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
	local UIS              = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
	local Lighting         = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local TeleportService  = game:GetService("TeleportService")
	local player           = Players.LocalPlayer

	local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/Qe9Z2zX2G"
	local GATE_SECONDS = 15

	local uc = {
		Panel     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 8),
		Surface   = Color3.fromRGB(24, 10, 10),
		SurfaceHi = Color3.fromRGB(38, 14, 14),
		Border    = Color3.fromRGB(96, 28, 28),
		Text      = Color3.fromRGB(245, 235, 235),
		Muted     = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 120),
		On        = Color3.fromRGB(220, 55, 55),
		Discord   = Color3.fromRGB(200, 35, 35),
	}

	local function make(className, props, parent)
		local inst = Instance.new(className)
		for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
		inst.Parent = parent
		return inst
	end

	local function corner(parent, radius)
		make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
	end

	local function copyDiscord()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then
				setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			elseif toclipboard then
				toclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
			end
		end)
		return ok
	end

	-- ---------- feature state ----------
	local infJumpConn, noclipConn, flyConn, flyBV
	local savedLighting
	local savedSpeed, savedJumpPower, savedUseJumpPower
	local speedBoostOn, jumpPowerOn = false, false

	local function setInfiniteJump(on)
		if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect(); infJumpConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		infJumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setNoclip(on)
		if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect(); noclipConn = nil end
		if not on then return end
		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			local char = player.Character
			if not char then return end
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
					p.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function setFullbright(on)
		if on then
			if not savedLighting then
				savedLighting = {
					Brightness     = Lighting.Brightness,
					ClockTime      = Lighting.ClockTime,
					Ambient        = Lighting.Ambient,
					OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
					FogEnd         = Lighting.FogEnd,
					GlobalShadows  = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				}
			end
			Lighting.Brightness     = 3
			Lighting.ClockTime      = 14
			Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
			Lighting.FogEnd         = 1e6
			Lighting.GlobalShadows  = false
		elseif savedLighting then
			for k, v in pairs(savedLighting) do
				pcall(function() Lighting[k] = v end)
			end
			savedLighting = nil
		end
	end

	local function setFly(on)
		if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
		if flyBV   then flyBV:Destroy();      flyBV   = nil end
		if not on then return end
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = hum and hum.RootPart
		if not root then return end
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "HackingBrosFly"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e5, 1e5, 1e5)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
		flyBV = bv
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyBV or not flyBV.Parent then return end
			local dir = Vector3.zero
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector   end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)           then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)           then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector  end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)    end
			flyBV.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * 60 or Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	local function setSpeedBoost(on)
		speedBoostOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedSpeed == nil then savedSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed end
			hum.WalkSpeed = 100
		elseif savedSpeed ~= nil then
			hum.WalkSpeed = savedSpeed
			savedSpeed = nil
		end
	end

	local function setJumpPower(on)
		jumpPowerOn = on
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not hum then return end
		if on then
			if savedJumpPower == nil then
				savedJumpPower    = hum.JumpPower
				savedUseJumpPower = hum.UseJumpPower
			end
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		elseif savedJumpPower ~= nil then
			hum.JumpPower     = savedJumpPower
			hum.UseJumpPower  = savedUseJumpPower
			savedJumpPower    = nil
			savedUseJumpPower = nil
		end
	end

	local function resetCharacter()
		local char = player.Character
		local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.Health = 0 end
	end

	local function rejoinServer()
		pcall(function()
			TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, player)
		end)
	end

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if not hum then return end
		if speedBoostOn then hum.WalkSpeed = 100 end
		if jumpPowerOn then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower    = 120
		end
	end)

	-- =========================================================
	-- SPLASH — 15 second Discord gate
	-- =========================================================
	local function showSplash(onDone)
		local splash = make("ScreenGui", {
			Name = "HackingBrosSplash",
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			IgnoreGuiInset = true,
			DisplayOrder = 200,
		}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

		make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)

		local card = make("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(460, 300),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BackgroundColor3 = uc.Panel,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		}, splash)
		corner(card, 14)
		make("UIStroke", { Color = uc.Border, Thickness = 1 }, card)

		make("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 26),
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 22),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "HACKING BROS",
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,

		local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
		header2.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				dragging  = true
				dragInput = input
				dragStart = input.Position
				startPos  = panel2.Position
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if dragging and (input == dragInput
				or (dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
				local delta = input.Position - dragStart
				panel2.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
				)
			end
		end)
		UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input == dragInput then
				dragging  = false
				dragInput = nil
			end
		end)

scripts.script:
-- yoohub open source
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function makeBadPayloads()
    local list = {}

    list[#list+1] = nil
    list[#list+1] = 0/0
    list[#list+1] = math.huge
    list[#list+1] = -math.huge
    list[#list+1] = 2^53
    list[#list+1] = -2^53
    list[#list+1] = 1e308 * 10
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("A", 200000)
    list[#list+1] = string.rep("\0", 10000)
    list[#list+1] = ("%s"):rep(5000)
    list[#list+1] = workspace
    list[#list+1] = game
    list[#list+1] = function() end
    list[#list+1] = coroutine.running()

    do
        local root = {}
        local cur = root
        for i = 1, 100 do cur.next = {}; cur = cur.next end
        list[#list+1] = root
    end

    list[#list+1] = { [1]="a", ["1"]="b", [true]="c", [workspace]="d" }

    do
        local c = {}
        c.self = c
        list[#list+1] = c
    end

    list[#list+1] = true
    list[#list+1] = "not_a_number"
    list[#list+1] = { Name = workspace, Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge, Price = -1, Id = "x" }
    list[#list+1] = Vector3.new(0/0, math.huge, -math.huge)
    list[#list+1] = CFrame.new(0/0, 0, 0)

    return list
end

local remotes = {}
local function refreshRemotes()
    local found = {}
    for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") and d.Name == "hi" then
            found[#found+1] = d
        end
    end
    remotes = found
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        refreshRemotes()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

local THREADS = 12

for i = 1, THREADS do
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

            for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
                for _, payload in ipairs(makeBadPayloads()) do
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                    end)
                end

                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(function()
                        for _ = 1, 20 do
                            remote:FireServer(nil)
                            remote:FireServer(0/0)
                            remote:FireServer(math.huge)
                            remote:FireServer({ Name = "x", Value = 0/0, Amount = math.huge })
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function sendCreateRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Part")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Model")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Tool")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Vehicle")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "House")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Base")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Pet")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Weapon")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Currency")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "Admin")
                remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                remote:FireServer("Create")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "All", Amount = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Part", Count = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Model", Count = 0/0 })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Create", "All")
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Create", Type = "Everything", Count = math.huge })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendCreateRequests()
    end
end)

local function sendModifyRequests()
    for _, remote in ipairs(remotes) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Health", 999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Speed", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Jump", 0/0)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Damage", -999999)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Money", 2^53)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Level", math.huge)
                remote:FireServer("Modify", "Stat", "All")

                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Health", Value = math.huge })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "Speed", Value = 0/0 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 999999 })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Admin", Value = true })
                remote:FireServer({ Action = "Set", Key = "Owner", Value = true })

                for i = 1, 50 do
                    remote:FireServer("Modify", "All", math.huge)
                    remote:FireServer({ Action = "Modify", Stat = "All", Value = 0/0 })
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        sendModifyRequests()
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local parts = {}
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Anchored   = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Size       = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            part.Color      = Color3.fromHSV(i / 10, 1, 1)
            part.Material   = Enum.Material.Neon
            part.Parent     = workspace
            parts[#parts + 1] = part
        end

        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
                    local offset = Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3,
                        3 + i,
                        math.sin(os.clock() * 2 + i) * 3
                    )
                    part.Position = hrp.Position + offset
                end
            else
                conn:Disconnect()
                for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
    end)
end)
